title: SOS
intro: Alert your trusted contacts with your location. Saakshi is not an emergency service.

setup.heading: Choose who to alert
setup.body: Add the people you trust. When you send an alert, each of them gets a text message with where you are and the time.

alert.hintDirect_one: Texts {{count}} contact 3 seconds after you tap. You can cancel.
alert.hintDirect_other: Texts {{count}} contacts 3 seconds after you tap. You can cancel.
alert.hintComposer_one: Opens your SMS app with the message to {{count}} contact. Tap Send there.
alert.hintComposer_other: Opens your SMS app with the message to {{count}} contacts. Tap Send there.
alert.sendRest: Send to the rest from my SMS app
alert.composerSent: Your SMS app sent the message.
alert.composerCancelled: Not sent. The message was closed without sending.
alert.composerUnknown: Your SMS app opened with the message. Check that it went.
alert.noLocation: Your location wasn't available, so the message has no map link.
alert.noSms: This phone can't send text messages.
alert.unexpected: The alert could not be sent: {{detail}}

message.title: Saakshi alert: I may need help.
message.liveInvite: Saakshi: follow my live location until {{time}}: {{link}}

contacts.title: Trusted contacts
contacts.intro: These people get your alerts by text message. The list is kept only on this phone.
contacts.name: Name (optional)
contacts.phoneHint: A 10-digit mobile number, or one starting with +
contacts.invalid: That doesn't look like a phone number.
contacts.duplicate: That number is already on the list.
contacts.full: The list is full. Remove someone to add another.

direct.heading: Send with no tap
direct.body: This version of Saakshi can text your contacts by itself, so an alert goes out even if you can't tap Send. Android asks you once to allow it.
direct.on: On: alerts go out by themselves after a 3-second countdown.
direct.denied: Not allowed. You can allow it in Android Settings, under Apps, Saakshi, Permissions.
direct.rationaleBody: Saakshi sends texts only when you send an alert, and only to your trusted contacts.

location.heading: Location
location.body: Allow location so your alerts include a map link to where you are.
location.denied: Location is off for Saakshi. Alerts will go without a map link until you allow it in the phone's Settings.

live.heading: Live location
live.body: Your trusted contacts get a link that shows where you are in any browser, until you stop. Your location goes to Saakshi's server only while sharing is on, and is deleted when it stops.
live.denied: Saakshi needs location permission to share where you are.
live.noticeBody: Your trusted contacts can see where you are until you stop.

bug.title: Bug mode
bug.intro: Bug mode records sound, for your own records, until you stop it or the battery runs out. It carries on with the screen locked. The sound is saved in pieces of 2 minutes, and each piece is fingerprinted and signed as it is saved.
bug.iosNote: While it records, iPhone shows a dot at the top of the screen and a Live Activity on the Lock Screen.
bug.androidNote: While it records, Android shows a notification.
bug.witnessOn: After each piece, its fingerprint is texted to your trusted contacts, at most 20 texts in 30 minutes.
bug.witnessOff: On this phone the fingerprints are not texted by themselves. You can send a witness message from the Record tab.
bug.localNote: The pieces stay on this phone, in the Record tab.
bug.failed_one: {{count}} piece could not be signed; it is kept as it is.
bug.failed_other: {{count}} pieces could not be signed; they are kept as they are.
bug.micDenied: Saakshi needs microphone permission for bug mode.
bug.noticeText: Bug mode is on. Open Saakshi to stop it.
bug.witness: Saakshi bug mode: piece {{n}}, {{from}} to {{to}}, saved and signed. SHA-256: {{hash}}

pad.title: Code
pad.noCode: No code has been set yet. Set one first, so this pad can send your alert.

trigger.title: Quick trigger
trigger.intro: Open a code pad in one step from outside the app, and send your alert by typing a 3-digit code. The alert goes out on the third correct digit. A wrong code does nothing.
trigger.codeHint: Not an emergency number such as 100, 108 or 112
trigger.format: The code must be exactly 3 digits.
trigger.emergency: That is an emergency or helpline number. Choose a different code.
trigger.actionConfiscation: Start confiscation mode (alert, live location and bug mode)
trigger.openHeading: How to open the code pad
trigger.iosControl: Control Center or Lock Screen: edit it, add a control, and choose Saakshi quick alert.
trigger.iosAction: Action Button (iPhone 15 Pro and later): Settings, Action Button, Controls, Saakshi quick alert.
trigger.iosWidget: Lock Screen widget: edit the Lock Screen and add Saakshi quick alert.
trigger.iosBackTap: Back Tap: in the Shortcuts app make a shortcut with Open Saakshi code pad, then choose it in Settings, Accessibility, Touch, Back Tap.
trigger.iosFaceId: From a locked iPhone, iOS may ask for Face ID or your passcode before the pad opens.
trigger.androidWidget: Home-screen widget: touch and hold the home screen, choose Widgets, and add Saakshi quick alert.
trigger.androidNotificationOn: The notification is on. Its button opens the code pad.
trigger.androidLocked: From a locked phone, Android asks you to unlock before the pad opens.
trigger.notificationText: Tap to open the code pad.

confiscation.title: Confiscation mode
confiscation.intro: Before you hand your phone over, start everything at once: your SOS alert with a live location link goes to your trusted contacts, and bug mode records sound. Each part can also be started on its own above.
confiscation.biometrics: Saakshi can't lock your phone. Turn off Face ID or fingerprint unlock first; see the preparedness guide.
confiscation.confirmBody: This sends your SOS alert, shares your live location and starts recording sound.
confiscation.stopAll: Stop live location and bug mode
